verdict.rationale: Zapier's core product is trigger-based automations (Zaps) that run autonomously in the background once set up, and this is extended with AI-native features like Zapier MCP and Agents for triggering/running workflows via AI clients. Community evidence confirms real-world autonomous background execution (e.g., a Zap misfiring and sending thousands of invites unattended), corroborating that these run without active user supervision. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of AI-triggered autonomous background runs (vs. classic Zaps), and detail on monitoring/error-recovery for unattended agentic runs beyond the troubleshooting-assistant mention.
